Asset type: one original fictional Hearts of Iron IV country-leader portrait candidate, exact eventual consumer canvas 156x210 pixels
Primary request: Create a distinctive painted leader bust for the fictional European cannibal warlord slot CBA. A fictional adult human man, bald with scalp clearly visible, holding a human skull in one hand near his chest and licking a small dark-red blood smear from its rim. Feral, bloodshot, asymmetrical gaze; a long narrow bony face, one eyebrow raised, irregular stained teeth, a small torn lower lip, and old facial scars. Restrained fictional war-horror blood only, with no exposed wounds or graphic body detail.

Use the inspected vanilla leader portrait family only as a high-level painted-style and head-and-shoulders-framing guide; do not copy any face or artwork.

Lighting/mood: Low natural overcast light, grim and feral, readable facial planes.
Color palette: Faded charcoal, bone beige, old olive, dried-blood red accents; subdued HOI4 leader-art contrast.
Materials/textures: Invented torn raw-cloth neck wrap under an asymmetrical rough hide collar and one scavenged 1930s-1940s field-coat shoulder; no authentic cultural or ceremonial clothing.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: One original human adult male only; unmistakably bald; distinctive fictional face, pose, clothing silhouette, skull placement, crop, and background. Opaque painted background. No actor, Hannibal Lecter, historical person, or vanilla portrait likeness.
Avoid: Photorealism, copied reference identity or artwork, other people, horns, antlers, undead traits, supernatural anatomy, prison/cell/bars/detention, prisoner clothing, Indigenous sacred or ceremonial motifs, generic tribal costume, symbols, insignia, text, logo, watermark, fake transparency, gore beyond restrained blood smears, or a cropped-out skull/hand.
